FaceThumbnail.description_en: The information about the thumbnail of the face. This parameter is valid only if the value-added image processing feature is enabled
FaceThumbnail.description_zh: 人脸缩略图信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效

face_group_id.description_en:
The ID of the group to which the face belongs.

The following specific IDs are included:

figure-cluster-id-independent: The face does not belong to a group. When you perform face clustering after an image is added to the dataset, this face may be grouped.
figure-cluster-id-unavailable: No clustering has been performed on this face. In other words, no face clustering is performed after an image is added to the dataset
face_group_id.description_zh:
人脸所属分组 id。

包含如下特定 id：

figure-cluster-id-independent：该人脸暂无合适的分组，后续在数据集中新增图片后进行人脸聚类操作时，该人脸可能被分入组中。

figure-cluster-id-unavailable：该人脸暂未进行过聚类操作，即在数据集中新增图片后，未进行人脸聚类
face_group_id.title: 人脸所属分组 id。

FaceThumbnail.title: 人脸缩略图信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。

auto_delete_left_sec.description_en: The remaining time in seconds before the file is automatically deleted from the recycle bin
auto_delete_left_sec.description_zh: 回收站文件自动删除剩余时间
auto_delete_left_sec.title: 回收站文件自动删除剩余时间

category.description_en: The category. The service categorizes files based on their file name extensions and MIME types. The main categories are doc, image, audio, and video
category.description_zh: 分类， pds 会根据文件的后缀名和 mime-type 对文件进行分类，主要分类有 doc, image, audio, video
category.title: 分类

content_hash_name.description_en: The name of the content hash algorithm. Currently, only sha1 is supported
content_hash_name.description_zh: 内容hash算法名，当前hash 算法支持sha1
content_hash_name.title: 内容hash算法名

created_at.description_en: The time when the file was created
created_at.title: 创建时间

dir_size_info.description_en: The statistics information of the folder. This parameter is returned when you call the list file or get file operation and include dir_size in the fields parameter
dir_size_info.description_zh: list file，get file 时，如果 fields 设置了 dir_size，那么该字段会返回，表示文件夹的统计信息

dir_count.description_en: The total number of subfolders in the folder, calculated recursively
dir_count.description_zh: 该文件夹下所有子孙文件夹数量，递归计算
dir_count.title: 文件夹数量

file_count.description_en: The total number of files in the folder, calculated recursively
file_count.description_zh: 该文件夹下所有子孙文件数量，递归计算
file_count.title: 文件数量

dir_size_info.title: 目录计量信息

download_url.description_en: The download URL. The URL is valid for 15 minutes by default. If the URL expires, call the GetFile operation to obtain a new one
download_url.description_zh: 下载链接， 下载链接默认有效期是 15 分钟，如果URL过期，可以通过 GetFile 进行获取
download_url.title: 下载链接

hidden.description_en: Indicates whether the file is hidden
hidden.title: 是否隐藏

image_media_metadata.description_en: The image information. This parameter is returned only if the image processing value-added service is enabled
image_media_metadata.description_zh: 图片信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效
image_media_metadata.title: 图片信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。

local_created_at.description_en: The local creation time of the file. This is the local time on the client at the moment of upload, which helps the client identify the local upload time
local_created_at.description_zh: 文件本地创建时间, 本地创建时间是指文件在上传时刻的本地时间，主要帮助客户端识别本地上传时间
local_created_at.title: 文件本地创建时间

local_modified_at.description_en: The local modification time of the file. This is the local time on the client at the moment of upload, which helps the client identify the local update time
local_modified_at.description_zh: 文件本地修改时间，文件本地更新时间, 本地更新时间是指文件在上传时刻的本地时间，主要帮助客户端识别本地更新时间
local_modified_at.title: 文件本地修改时间

parent_file_id.description_en: The ID of the parent folder
parent_file_id.title: 父文件夹id

revision_id.description_en: The revision ID. A new revision ID is generated when a file with the same file ID is overwritten
revision_id.description_zh: 版本id， 当相同file-id 文件覆盖上传时， 会有新的revision_id 产生
revision_id.title: 版本id

size.description_en:
If the object is a file, this parameter indicates the file size.

If the object is a folder, this parameter indicates the total size of all files within it. The size is calculated recursively. Note: The folder size is returned only when you include dir_size in the fields parameter of a list file or get file request
size.description_zh:
如果是文件，表示文件大小

如果是文件夹，表示文件夹的大小（递归计算所有子孙文件的大小）
备注：文件夹大小只有在 list file，get file 时设置 fields 包含 dir_size 时才会返回
size.title: 大小

starred.description_en: Indicates whether the file is starred
starred.title: 是否收藏

status.description_en: The status. Only files and folders in the available state can be accessed. If a file is in the uploading state, the GetFile operation returns a "file not found" error, and the ListFile operation does not return the file
status.description_zh: 状态，只有available的文件和目录才是可以被访问的，如果文件处于uploading状态，GetFile会返回文件不存在, ListFile也不会返回uploading状态的文件
status.title: 状态

thumbnail.description_en: The thumbnail URL. This parameter is deprecated. Use thumbnail_urls instead
thumbnail.description_zh: 缩略图地址（已废弃，推荐使用thumbnail_urls）
thumbnail.title: 缩略图地址

additionalProperties.description_en: The returned thumbnail information. The keys in this object correspond to the keys passed in the thumbnail_processes request parameter
additionalProperties.description_zh: 返回的缩略图信息，与入参thumbnail_processes中传入的key对应

thumbnail_urls.description_en: The returned thumbnail information. The keys in this object correspond to the keys passed in the thumbnail_processes request parameter
thumbnail_urls.description_zh: 返回的缩略图信息，与入参thumbnail_processes中传入的key对应
thumbnail_urls.title: 返回的缩略图信息

trashed_at.description_en: The time when the file was moved to the recycle bin
trashed_at.title: 放入回收站时间

updated_at.description_en: The time when the file was last modified
updated_at.title: 修改时间

ImageMediaMetadata.description_en: The image metadata. This parameter is valid only if the value-added image processing feature is enabled
ImageMediaMetadata.description_zh: 图片元数据。仅当开启增值服务图片处理功能有效

city.description_en: The city in which the image was taken
city.title: 城市。

country.description_en: The country or region in which the image was taken
country.title: 国家或地区。

district.description_en: The district in which the image was taken
district.title: 区。

exif.description_en: The EXIF information about the image
exif.title: 图片EXIF信息。

height.description_en: The height of the image. Unit: pixel
height.title: 图片高度，单位为像素（px）。

image_tags.description_en: The details of the image tags

items.description_en: The system tag.(this data structure will be closed in Feb. 20,2025)
items.description_zh: 系统标签（该数据结构将于2025年2月20日起停止透出）

image_tags.title: 图片标签详情列表

province.description_en: The province in which the image was taken
province.title: 省。

time.description_en: The time when the image was taken. The time follows the RFC3339 standard
time.title: 拍摄时间，RFC3339 格式。

township.description_en: The street in which the image was taken
township.title: 街道。

width.description_en: The width of the image. Unit: pixel
width.title: 图片宽度，单位为像素（px）。

ImageMediaMetadata.title: 图片信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。

ImageQuality.description_en: The details of the image quality. This parameter takes effect only if the value-added image processing feature is enabled
ImageQuality.description_zh: 图片评分详情。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效

overall_score.description_en: The overall quality score of the image. The image is automatically evaluated by AI. The evaluation is mainly based on subjective aesthetics and is affected by various factors, such as composition, brightness, contrast, color, and definition. Valid values: 0 to 1. The higher the score, the better the quality
overall_score.description_zh: 图片整体质量评分。该评分为 AI 自动评估，主要以主观美学为准，受到构图、亮度、对比度、色彩、清晰度等多方面因素影响。  范围 0-1，评分越高则质量越好
overall_score.title: 图片整体质量评分。该评分为 AI 自动评估，主要以主观美学为准，受到构图、亮度、对比度、色彩、清晰度等多方面因素影响。  范围 0-1，越高则质量越好。

ImageQuality.title: 图片评分详情。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。

SystemTag.description_en: The system AI processing tag. This parameter is valid only if the value-added image processing feature is enabled.(this data structure will be closed in Feb. 20,2025)
SystemTag.description_zh: 系统AI处理标签。仅当开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。（该数据结构将于2025年2月20日起停止透出）

centric_score.description_en: The center value of the tag, which specifies whether the tag is the subject in the image. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value of 0 specifies the lowest proportion. A value of 1 specifies the highest proportion
centric_score.description_zh: 标签的中心值分数，指该标签在图片中是否为主体，取值范围为 0（主体比重最小）~1（主体比重最大）
centric_score.title: 标签的中心值分数，指该标签在图片中是否为主体，取值范围为 0~1。

confidence.description_en: The confidence level of the tag. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value of 0 specifies the lowest confidence level. A value of 1 specifies the highest confidence level
confidence.description_zh: 标签置信度，取值范围为 0（表示置信度最低）~1（表示置信度最高）
confidence.title: 标签置信度，取值范围为 0（表示置信度最低）~1（表示置信度最高）。

parent_name.description_en: The name of the parent tag of the tag
parent_name.title: 标签父标签。

tag_level.description_en: The level of the tag. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
tag_level.description_zh: 标签层级，取值范围大于等于 1
tag_level.title: 标签层级，取之范围大于等于 1。

SystemTag.title: 标签详细信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能有效。

VideoMediaAudioStream.description_zh: 音频流信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能或视频转码功能有效

bit_rate.description_zh: 音频比特率，单位为比特每秒（bps）
bit_rate.title: 音频比特率，单位为比特每秒（bps）。

VideoMediaAudioStream.title: 音频流信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能或视频转码功能有效。

height.description_en: The video frame height, in pixels (px)
height.description_zh: 视频画面高度，单位为像素（px）
height.title: 视频画面高度，单位为像素（px）。

width.description_en: The video frame width, in pixels (px)
width.description_zh: 视频画面宽度，单位为像素（px）
width.title: 视频画面宽度，单位为像素（px）。

VideoMediaMetadata.title: 音视频信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能或视频转码功能有效。

VideoMediaVideoStream.description_zh: 视频流信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能或视频转码功能有效

bitrate.description_zh: 视频流比特率，单位为比特率每秒（bps）
bitrate.title: 视频流比特率，单位为比特率每秒（bps）。

duration.description_zh: 视频流持续时长，单位为秒（s）
duration.title: 视频流持续时长，单位为秒（s）。

VideoMediaVideoStream.title: 视频流信息。仅开启增值服务图片处理功能或视频转码功能有效。

description_en: Lists files shared with the current user from a personal space
description_zh: 收到的共享， 可通过此接口获取到从个人空间授权给此用户的文件列表
name: ListReceivedFile

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of items to return. The value cannot exceed 100. If you do not specify this parameter, the default is 100
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回100，最大不能超过100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The pagination marker from a previous response. The query continues from the position indicated by this marker. If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning of the file list
parameters.help_zh: 设置此字段后，数据会从上次返回的位置开始继续返回。如果不设定，则从头开始返回数据。 默认值：无
parameters.name: marker

next_marker.description_en: The pagination marker for the next page of results. Pass this value in the marker parameter of a subsequent request to retrieve the next page
next_marker.description_zh: 本次返回记录的断点，可用于下次继续查询
